before.title: Runtime EXECUTE on recovery terms, payer mark, fee, landing and allocation routines

target.note: kept as checked routines; actor and tenant bound at LP-6c; no fee rule changed

responsibilities.LP-6c: money routines compare p_actor and p_tenant with the binding; fee posting is not changed here
responsibilities.LP-8a: allocation, reversal and fee-journal paths enforce actor, resource, amount, state and exact approval

before.downstream: Checked recovery operations including write_recovery_allocation (M4-8-S) over the six SELECT-only allocation tables; preserved, not widened. MON-4A adds only read_payment_fees/write_payment_fee checked synthetic statements/approvals; private sources and two immutable tables have no runtime table grant. No posting or collection authority is added.
